title: Payment Terms, Deposit Holds and Settlement Times on Car Hire
content:
These are the payment terms of the six Car Rental Rate Classes: whether the rental is taken in advance and
in what share, the amount held on the renter's card at collection, the markup carried where the renter
elects a currency other than the supplier's own, and the time an approved refund takes to settle.

| Rate class | Whole rental taken at booking | Share of the rental total taken at booking, as a percentage | Deposit held at collection, in USD | Currency conversion markup, as a percentage | Settlement of an approved refund, in business days |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pay Now Saver Rate | yes | 100 | 500 | 3.5 | 0 |
| Pay Now Standard Rate | yes | 100 | 400 | 3.5 | 14 |
| Pay At Counter Flex Rate | no | 0 | 350 | 3 | 10 |
| Inclusive Flex Rate | no | 0 | 250 | 2.5 | 7 |
| Premium Inclusive Rate | no | 0 | 150 | 2 | 5 |
| Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate | no | 0 | 300 | 2 | 10 |

The two classes taken in advance are taken in full: their share is 100 per cent, and no class publishes a
part share. The four classes not taken in advance publish a share of nothing, which means nothing is taken
at booking on them.

The deposit is held at collection and is the largest on the class taken in full at the lowest rate, at
500 USD, and the smallest on the Premium Inclusive Rate, at 150 USD. It is a hold and not a share of the
rental, and it is not affected by the class's payment terms.

The currency conversion markup falls with the class, from 3.5 per cent on the two Pay Now classes to 2 per
cent on the Premium Inclusive Rate and the Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate.

The settlement column is a count of business days. It stands at nothing on the Pay Now Saver Rate and runs
to 14 business days on the Pay Now Standard Rate, with 10, 7, 5 and 10 business days on the others.
